item.name: Maelstrom

effects.title: Chain Lightning
effects.text: Grants a 25% chance on attack to release a bolt of electricity that leaps between 4 targets within a 650 radius, dealing 110 magical damage to each. Lightning proc pierces evasion.

item.lore: A hammer forged for the gods themselves, Maelstrom allows its user to harness the power of lightning.
